acceptance: Official results carry no qphh_at_size, and no output labels a refresh-free composite as official QphH
Docs (including docs/concepts/glossary.md) state the deviation and point to the follow-up
context: Owner decision 2026-10-04: suppress now; RF1/RF2 implementation moved to tpch-refresh-functions-in-power-and-throughput. 2026-10-04 throughput adversarial review (develop 8ed0c64e1); absence of RF verified by search.
description:
The TPC-H power test runs the 22 queries only (tpch/power_test.py:376-389) and the geometric mean uses only query times (metrics.py:121-151). The throughput test has no refresh stream (no RF code in tpch/throughput_test.py or core/throughput). Maintenance runs afterwards with `concurrent_with_queries=False` (execution.py:692-698). Verified: no refresh/RF1/RF2 references in the TPC-H power or throughput test modules.

The TPC-H spec defines Power@Size with the 24th root over the 22 query times and RF1 and RF2, and requires the throughput test to run S pairs of RF1/RF2 in a refresh stream concurrently with the query streams. Without them QphH@Size is overstated, but it is exported under the official name for `--official` runs. docs/concepts/glossary.md:168 describes the current behavior as intended.
